name: pr-status
description: A dependency-free runtime action that checks pull request status on GitHub.com

scripts.package: node --input-type=module -e "import {rmSync} from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && ncc build src/index.ts -o dist --source-map --license licenses.txt && node --input-type=module -e "import {closeSync, openSync} from 'node:fs'; closeSync(openSync('dist/licenses.txt', 'a'))"
scripts.test: npm run ci-test && npm run coverage-badge
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package

author: Grant Birkinbine
